sources.title: speechbrain/speechbrain: A PyTorch-based Speech Toolkit - GitHub
sources.snippet: SpeechBrain is an open-source PyTorch toolkit that accelerates Conversational AI development, i.e., the technology behind speech assistants, chatbots, and large language models. It is crafted for fast and easy creation of advanced technologies for Speech and Text Processing.

sources.title: SpeechBrain: Open-Source Conversational AI for Everyone - GitHub
sources.snippet: SpeechBrain offers user-friendly tools for training Language Models, supporting technologies ranging from basic n-gram LMs to modern Large Language Models. Our platform seamlessly integrates them into speech processing pipelines and facilitates the creation of customizable chatbots.

sources.title: SpeechBrain: Open-Source Conversational AI for Everyone
sources.snippet: SpeechBrain offers pre-trained models with user-friendly interfaces, making tasks like transcription, speaker verification, speech enhancement, and source separation easier than ever.
